content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they’re not built for you. Stripe excludes Kenya. PayPal locks accounts without warning. Local gateways crash during traffic spikes. This stack bypasses all of it. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store for free—unaffected by regional restrictions. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, scaling to millions of requests without additional cost. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a flat 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. Your orders are stored in Supabase, a scalable database you control. Files are delivered via Cloudflare R2, fast and reliable. Every component is chosen for sovereignty: you own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform can shut you down. No geography can block you. This isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure designed for creators in markets platforms ignore.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather these assets: your ebook files (PDF, EPUB, MOBI), a domain name (optional but recommended), and a NOWPayments account. Sign up for Cloudflare (free tier works) and create a Supabase project. If you’re using the Complete Builder Kit, download the templates and blueprints from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. You’ll also need a text editor to customize the code. No coding experience? The kit includes pre-configured templates. Focus on what you control: your content, your pricing, your branding. Everything else is handled by the stack. If you’re in Kenya, test your internet connection—Cloudflare’s edge network compensates for latency, but a stable upload is required for initial deployment. You’re not renting a platform. You’re building infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with payments. In NOWPayments, create a payment link for your ebook. Set the price in USD or a stablecoin like USDT. Select BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees (under $0.10 per transaction). Copy the webhook URL—this triggers file delivery when payment confirms. Next, upload your ebook to Cloudflare R2. Create a signed URL in Cloudflare Workers that expires after 15 minutes. This URL is sent to the buyer post-payment. In Supabase, create a table to log orders. The webhook from NOWPayments writes to this table automatically. Test the flow: simulate a payment, verify the file URL is generated, and ensure the order is logged. Your pipeline is now secure, automated, and entirely under your control. No platform touches your customer’s data. No geography limits your reach.
Your store runs on infrastructure you own—no platform can shut it down.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages. Connect your domain (or use the free Cloudflare subdomain). Push the code from your local machine or GitHub repository. Once live, test the entire flow: place an order, send a test payment, and confirm the ebook is delivered. Monitor the Supabase dashboard to see the order logged. Check your NOWPayments dashboard for transaction details. Your first sale proves the infrastructure works. Share the store link with your audience. No need to explain crypto—NOWPayments handles the buyer experience. You focus on selling. The stack handles the rest. Your store is now a sovereign entity, operational 24/7, immune to platform failures and geographic restrictions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the stack live, scale strategically. Add more products by duplicating the payment link template in NOWPayments and updating the file delivery logic in Cloudflare Workers. Monitor Supabase for order volume—if you exceed the free tier, upgrade to a paid plan (still cheaper than platform fees). Optimize for mobile—Kenyan buyers often use smartphones. Use Cloudflare’s edge caching to speed up load times. Track revenue in your NOWPayments dashboard. Reinvest profits into marketing or new products. The infrastructure is designed to grow with you. No platform limits. No geographic barriers. You’re not renting scalability—you’re building it. Your store is now a self-sustaining commerce engine, powered by tools that don’t discriminate based on location.

To sell ebooks from Kenya without Stripe or PayPal, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, NOWPayments for crypto transactions, Supabase for order storage, and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This infrastructure bypasses geographic restrictions, eliminates platform dependencies, and gives you full control over your store. The Complete Builder Kit provides pre-configured templates and blueprints to accelerate deployment. With this stack, you accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, deliver files instantly, and operate without subscriptions or third-party fees. Your store is live in 48 hours, pressure-tested for markets platforms ignore.
Accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee, no KYC required.

Ready to deploy your sovereign ebook store? The Complete Builder Kit includes all blueprints, templates, and guides needed to launch your infrastructure in 48 hours. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to download instantly. This kit is built for creators in Kenya, Ghana, and other regions where conventional platforms fail. No coding required. No platform dependencies. Just infrastructure you own.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather assets: ebook files, domain (optional), NOWPayments account.
2. Sign up for Cloudflare and Supabase (free tiers work).
3. Download the Complete Builder Kit templates and blueprints.
4. Customize the payment link in NOWPayments for your ebook.
5. Upload your ebook to Cloudflare R2 and configure signed URLs.
6. Set up the Supabase table to log orders.
7. Test the payment-to-delivery pipeline with a simulated transaction.
8. Deploy the store to Cloudflare Pages.
9. Connect your domain or use the free Cloudflare subdomain.
10. Monitor the Supabase and NOWPayments dashboards post-launch.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept local currency payments with this stack?

Yes, but indirectly. Set your ebook price in a stablecoin like USDT. Buyers can convert local currency to crypto on exchanges like Binance or Yellow Card. The stack processes the crypto payment, delivering the ebook instantly.
What if my buyers aren’t familiar with cryptocurrency?

NOWPayments handles the buyer experience. Buyers scan a QR code or click a payment link. They don’t need a crypto wallet—they can pay directly from an exchange. The process is as simple as any online payment.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your NOWPayments dashboard. Since you control the infrastructure, you decide refund policies. Communicate these clearly in your store’s terms of service.
Can I sell multiple products with this stack?
Yes. Duplicate the payment link template in NOWPayments for each product. Update the file delivery logic in Cloudflare Workers to match the product. The stack scales with your catalog.
What happens if Cloudflare or Supabase goes down?

Cloudflare’s uptime is 99.99%. Supabase runs on Postgres, a proven database. If either fails, your store pauses—but your data is safe. No platform can delete your store or lock your account. You retain full control.
